description: This file defines the NotANumberException class, a custom exception used within the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a provided number is not a number (NaN). It extends MathIllegalNumberException and uses localized message formats.

classes.name: NotANumberException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a number is not a number (NaN). Extends MathIllegalNumberException to provide context-specific error handling.

methods.name: NotANumberException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a localized message indicating NaN is not allowed.
